title: Tech Note: Preemptive Processes on 4D Remote
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Preemptive multitasking, thread-safety declarations, and the New Network Layer requirement described here remain the current 4D concurrency model; this note's technical content is still accurate. The main change since 2019 is that 32-bit 4D and the legacy network layer are now long obsolete/removed, so the conditional caveats about needing 64-bit or opting into the new network layer are now moot — those are simply the only options in current 4D.
related_updates: 32-bit 4D versions and the legacy network layer have since been fully phased out, making the 'requirements' in this note the unconditional default rather than an opt-in choice
The Signal object and CALL WORKER/New process patterns for mixing preemptive and cooperative code remain 4D's current concurrency toolkit
